auditRounds.focus: Rollback failure injection and host/project portability
findingsFixed: Multiple failed mutation generations needed newest-first rollback.
Build infrastructure and engine-selection failures needed same-generation retry without treating the mutation as bad.
A build-executor exception could leave bookkeeping stuck.
An untouched pre-image journal could be misreported as a recovery conflict.
Malformed declared control v2 could otherwise fall back to nested legacy actions.
Same-hash source symbol evidence needed accumulation while changed hashes needed a reset.
Complete absent filename evidence needed the project-relative search scope in its canonical path.
Completion-audit intent detection was narrowed so generic broad validation requests are not over-gated.

claims.claim: ControlEnvelope v2 makes the persisted Python task state authoritative and prevents stale or nested legacy actions from reopening an older route.

evidence.observation: The task control projection owns epoch, disposition, exact required tool, allowed tools, retry policy, and blocker fingerprint.
The compactor projects authoritative server control before considering legacy action fields.
Highest-epoch, terminal, malformed-v2, checkpoint-resume, and hard-compaction route replays passed in the 148-test Compactor suite.

counterEvidence.observation: A declared but malformed v2 envelope is explicitly tested to fail closed instead of mining a nested legacy tool action.

claims.claim: Direct-source and absent evidence are server-owned, hash/range bound, and completion-frontier validation is limited to explicit missing-implementation audits.

evidence.observation: Successful source reads merge covered ranges and symbols only while the content hash remains current.
Completion-audit detection uses narrow explicit missing/incomplete-feature phrases; generic all-patches or all-tests requests do not activate it.
Positive and negative English/Korean request boundaries, current hash/range evidence, and complete absence are covered by deterministic tests.
Same-hash range/symbol accumulation, changed-hash reset, scoped absence, and NOT_FOUND-to-complete-search transitions passed.

counterEvidence.observation: Free text cannot replace typed frontier claims for a true completion audit.
Generic broad validation wording remains outside the completion-frontier gate.

evidence.observation: Startup recovery inspects incomplete journals and preserves external-change conflicts.

Crash recovery, terminal build rollback, external-change CAS protection, reverse multi-generation rollback, delete restore, and successful finalization passed.
